% ---- Inputs: estimators and their inputs (definitions from PAPER_DESIGN.md sec. 6; beam scalar names from b79)
\newcommand{\TabInputs}{{\footnotesize\setlength{\tabcolsep}{4pt}\begin{tabular}{@{}lll@{}}\toprule
name & reads & role \\
\midrule
H (hold) & \parbox[t]{10.2cm}{\raggedright newest visible CES value\strut} & baseline \\
G (causal GP) & \parbox[t]{10.2cm}{\raggedright last 16 visible values; Mat\'ern-3/2, hyperparameters by marginal likelihood per sample\strut} & CES-only baseline \\
T0 & \parbox[t]{10.2cm}{\raggedright G + boosted regression on 10 history scalars (time step, age of the newest value, H, $G-H$, $|G-H|$, mean, sd, $H$ $-$ mean, last increment and number of the last ten values)\strut} & history only \\
TX & \parbox[t]{10.2cm}{\raggedright T0 inputs + 8 fast scalars (level of the BES and ECEI array means, departure from the mean of the ten rows before, its sd, one-row increment) + 6 anchor scalars (fast level at the anchor row, change since, log ratio of raw levels)\strut} & the estimator \\
TE, TB & \parbox[t]{10.2cm}{\raggedright T0 inputs + the ECEI half or the BES half\strut} & which diagnostic \\
TN, TXN & \parbox[t]{10.2cm}{\raggedright T0 or TX inputs + 19 beam scalars: power of NBI-1, of NBI-2 and their total at row $t$, at the anchor row and the difference (9); running means of the total over 10 and 50 rows at row $t$ and at the anchor row (4); on/off flags of the five sources that are ever on (5); voltage of source NB1B (1)\strut} & comparison rows \\
O & \parbox[t]{10.2cm}{\raggedright the frame's own reading (scored against L5 only)\strut} & reference \\
\bottomrule\end{tabular}}}
\newcommand{\CapInputs}{Estimators and their inputs (KSTAR). Fast samples and beam waveforms are visible up to row $t$ under every rule; CES values only as the availability rule allows. Boosted regression: HistGradientBoostingRegressor, default settings, one per rule and target.}

Cost of staleness = MSE(T0, rule) / MSE(T0, D10) on the same rows; increment = reduction of the MSE of TX against T0; recovered share = (MSE(T0) $-$ MSE(TX)) / (MSE(T0) $-$ MSE(T0, D10)).
